title: #044. Security Policy Counterexample Search (SMT)
subtitle: Prove a safety invariant by refutation: assert all policy rules together with not(safeInvariant) in Z3 to find a concrete violation.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { hasViolation, counterexample }.
judge.m1: When hasViolation is false, counterexample must be null.
judge.m2: A valid counterexample violating the safety invariant exists, yet hasViolation: false was returned.
judge.m4: Counterexample actually satisfies safeInvariant instead of violating it.
judge.m5: Safety invariant proven: no state satisfies all policy rules while violating safeInvariant.
